description: This file contains the `BreadcrumbsUtils` class, a utility component for building breadcrumb navigation structures for categories and products within a shopping web application. It interacts with category services and constructs breadcrumb objects with hierarchical links based on category lineage and product context.

classes.name: BreadcrumbsUtils
classes.description: A Spring component utility class for constructing breadcrumb navigation objects for categories and products.

methods.name: buildCategoryBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds a breadcrumb trail for a clicked category, including parent categories up to the root, based on category lineage and store context.

methods.name: buildProductBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb trail for a product, optionally including category hierarchy based on provided reference content.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses breadcrumb reference string into a list of category IDs.

methods.name: parseCategoryLineage
methods.description: Parses category lineage string into a list of category ID strings.

methods.name: buildBreadCrumb
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb string from a list of category IDs.
